🚨 We're hiring: Investment Analyst – Dubai, UAE

💼 Role: Investment Analyst
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💰 Salary: AED 9,500 to 12,500 per month
🎓 Experience: 2+ years
⏰ Last date to apply: 11 December 2026

📝 Hiring now: an Investment Analyst in Dubai, UAE. If you are organised and reliable, this role is for you.

📌 What you will do:
• Analyse financial and commercial information
• Monitor portfolio and transaction updates
• Support due diligence activities
• Research investment opportunities and markets
• Follow company policies and procedures

🎓 What we are looking for:
• 2+ years of relevant experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Business (CA, CMA, ACCA or CPA is a plus)
• Good knowledge of financial analysis
• Practical understanding of valuation fundamentals
• Good time management
• Team player with a positive attitude
• Fluent English communication

🌟 A stable, long-term opportunity.

📧 Interested? Send your CV to job@financeinme.com.

♻️ Know someone who would be a great fit? Please repost to help them see it.

Please never pay money to get a job.

posts.author: Sandra Serag
posts.content:
We Are Hiring: MIS Executive | Al Ain

We are currently looking for an experienced MIS Executive to join our team in Dubai.

Requirements:
-Minimum 2 years of experience in MIS, Data Analysis, Reporting, or a similar role.
-Bilingual in Arabic and English is a MUST.
-Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query, Dashboards).
-Experience in data management, reporting, and performance tracking.
-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
-Ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
-Experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is an added advantage.
-Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
-Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Location: Al Ain

ONLY APPLICATIONS IN UAE WILL BE CONSIDERED

If you meet the above criteria and are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to: sandramohamed.serag@teleperformance.com

Kindly note that if you are not contacted, your application has not passed the CV screening process.

🚀🌟 WE ARE HIRING | ODOO DEVELOPER - Full Time 🌟🚀
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE 🇦🇪
💰 Salary: AED 16,000 per month
💼 Experience: 5+ Years

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💻 MUST-HAVE SKILLS
🔹 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
🔹 4+ years of Python development experience
🔹 2+ years of Odoo module development (Odoo 15–18)
🔹 Strong PostgreSQL skills – queries, indexing & performance tuning
🔹 JavaScript + OWL (Odoo Web Library)
🔹 Git workflow & Odoo.sh deployment experience
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⭐ NICE TO HAVE
✅ Odoo Functional Certification
✅ UAE VAT & WPS implementation experience in Odoo
✅ Arabic language proficiency
✅ Linux Administration / Docker / CI-CD basics
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
🔸 Develop new Odoo modules and customize existing modules
🔸 Conduct code reviews, testing & deployment through Odoo.sh
🔸 Integrate Odoo with Shopify, payment gateways, e-invoicing & banking systems
🔸 Collaborate with implementation consultants to convert business requirements into technical solutions
🔸 Maintain shared internal libraries used across multiple group companies

📧 HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates, please share your updated CV at:
📩 info@vpselitehr.com
